{{Quote|Take those controls--they'll let you pilot a submersible droid that can drop the mines.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]]|<ref name="TOR:Fortification">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|Fortification|Manaan}}</ref>}}
A model of '''submersible minelayer droid''' was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. Such submersible droid was employed during the [[Invasion of Manaan|invasion]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] to deploy [[underwater mine]]s in order to defend the [[Imperial Kolto Mining Facility]].<ref name="TOR:Fortification"/>
